description: Verify an x402 seller before you pay it. Reads the seller's payment request (HTTP 402) without paying and returns ok, caution or avoid with a 0-100 risk score and reasons: who gets paid, asset, network and price, plus an OFAC sanctions and scam-list check on the payee. Flags burn-address payees, unknown tokens, testnets, mismatched networks and very high prices. Never pays or signs. Not charged for invalid input or unreachable sellers. Paid via x402; see list_prices.

method.description: Optional: GET or POST. Default tries GET, then POST if GET is refused.

url.description: The x402 endpoint URL to check (https).

name: x402_seller_check
title: Is this x402 seller safe to pay? Reads the seller's payment request and returns ok, caution or avoid
